files.name: lib/Conversation.svelte
files.contents:
<script>
	import { Module, Bubble, Divider, Reply } from 'mercury';

	let messages = $state([
		{
			text: 'Let me get back to you on that. My schedule is kinda crazy right now with the launch.',
			time: 'Mon 11:25 PM',
			outgoing: true
		},
		{ divider: 'New messages' },
		{ text: 'Haha. Oh man' },
		{ text: "I'm excited to see this beast", avatar: 'ML', time: 'Mon 11:50 PM' }
	]);

	/** @param {string} text */
	function send(text) {
		messages.push({ text, outgoing: true, time: 'Just now' });
	}
</script>

<Module title="Mara Lindqvist @maralind" source="Conversation" kind="social">
	{#each messages as message, i (i)}
		{#if message.divider}
			<Divider label={message.divider} />
		{:else}
			<Bubble
				text={message.text}
				time={message.time}
				avatar={message.avatar}
				outgoing={message.outgoing}
			/>
		{/if}
	{/each}
	<Reply onsend={send} />
</Module>

files.name: lib/Music.svelte
files.contents:
<script>
	import { Module, Media, Actions, Action, ListRow, Art } from 'mercury';

	const tracks = ['Harbor Lights', 'Low Tide'];
	/** @type {string | null} */
	let playing = $state(null);
	let saved = $state(false);
</script>

<Module title="Low Tide" source="Music" kind="music">
	<Media title="Low Tide" subtitle="Single by Juno Vale">
		{#snippet art()}
			<Art kind="album" tone="cool" />
		{/snippet}
		<Actions>
			<Action
				icon="play"
				label={playing ? 'Pause' : 'Play'}
				onclick={() => (playing = playing ? null : tracks[0])}
			/>
			<Action icon={saved ? 'check' : 'save'} label={saved ? 'Saved' : 'Save'} onclick={() => (saved = true)} />
		</Actions>
	</Media>

	{#each tracks as track, i (track)}
		<ListRow
			index={i + 1}
			label={track}
			trailing={playing === track ? 'Playing' : ''}
			onclick={() => (playing = track)}
		/>
	{/each}
</Module>
